aliases: 5MP Indoor Fixed-focal Wi-Fi Pan & Tilt Network Camera
features: motorized pan & tilt (Pan 0-355, Tilt -5 to 80) with auto tracking
smart dual light: IR + warm-light colorful night vision (up to 10 m)
Wi-Fi 6 dual-band (IEEE 802.11b/g/n/a/ac/ax 2.4/5 GHz) + RJ-45 ethernet + Bluetooth pairing
2 W enhanced speaker with AI noise reduction, two-way talk
AI human and pet detection, abnormal sound alarm, one-click privacy mode
microSD up to 256 GB, DMSS app
release_notes: The Dahua Hero H5AS is a 5MP indoor fixed-focal Wi-Fi 6 pan & tilt camera with auto tracking, smart dual-light colorful night vision, AI human/pet detection and a 2 W enhanced speaker. Verified against the official Dahua datasheet.

home_assistant.notes: Consumer Wi-Fi pan-tilt camera managed via the DMSS app; ONVIF/RTSP is not stated on the datasheet. Add via the Generic Camera integration if RTSP is exposed.

blue_iris.notes: Select the 'Dahua' profile; RTSP is not confirmed on the datasheet.
